formula_a.name: Formula A
formula_a.ranking_source: current official competition table at request time; include completed matches that day
formula_a.fixtures: previous 3 actual first-team matches + current match + next 2 confirmed first-team matches, all competitions including confirmed friendlies
formula_a.days_formula: Rest Days = current date - previous match date - 1

formula_b.name: Formula B / UCL template
formula_b.fatigue: Not Tired/Tired/Very Tired based on previous actual first-team matches

formula_c.name: Formula C
formula_c.ranking_source: use analyzed competition current official table whenever that competition has its own table; otherwise domestic official table

future_density.rule: start from current match; current→next1 <=3 gives ☑️; if next1→next2 <=3 gives ☑️×2; otherwise ☑️; >=4 on first check gives ❌

formula_c.next_3: next 3 confirmed first-team matches in chronological order, all competitions including confirmed friendlies
formula_c.want_win: only when clearly enough strength and conditions exist to beat opponent; otherwise Hope Win
formula_c.dont_lose_gate: after all old factors support Don't Lose, next opponent must be 优 OR both next two opponents must each be two strength tiers above
formula_c.same_strength_rule: if teams are close and no clear basis, use ---
intent_factors: UEFA full 8/6-match schedule and home/away opportunity cost
